lines: This place is different. The walls glow with embedded crystalline veins — not bioluminescence, but something deeper, geological.
The ground vibrates beneath your feet. A low hum fills the air, felt more than heard. It resonates in your chest, in your teeth, in the soles of your boots.
No creatures here. The darkness is absolute except for the crystal veins, but it doesn't feel hostile. It feels... attentive.

actions.text: A massive crystalline form stands near the center of the chamber. Semi-translucent, embedded in the rock itself. It could be a statue — or it could be sleeping.

lines: The Crystal Guardian shatters, its crystalline body fragmenting into glowing shards that slowly dim.
Among the debris, a dense core remains — still humming with energy. A power source unlike anything manufactured.
You place your hand on the stone. The vibration intensifies.
Images flash — not quite memories, not quite visions. A world before the darkness. Before the light. Before the divide. Something whole.

A network of crystal veins stretching through the planet like nerves through a body. Energy flowing along pathways older than anything human. A slow, vast consciousness — not thinking the way you think, but aware. Present. Patient.
Then silence. The vibration fades. But something has changed.

Your Sol Unit's display flickers with a new symbol you've never seen before. And in your hand, a fragment of the resonance point has broken free — a shard of living crystal that still hums with the planet's voice.
The Underlumen isn't dead. It's sleeping. And it just noticed you.

actions.text: The resonance point is quiet now. But you can still feel the vibration — faintly, constantly, like a second heartbeat. It's always been there. You just couldn't feel it before.

lines: The Umbral Seed in your pack suddenly flares with light — brighter than you've ever seen it. It's responding to the Hum.
The vibration in the chamber intensifies momentarily, as if the Underlumen recognizes the seed. Old friends meeting.
The seed has changed. Its bioluminescence has shifted from pale green to deep violet. When you replant it, something different will grow.
